verdict.rationale: CRA documents EFILE as a sanctioned system-to-system transmitter channel. Software developers go through a CRA certification process (cra-docs-19), and enrolled electronic filers transmit client returns directly from certified software using an EFILE number and password (cra-docs-14, cra-docs-16, cra-docs-17), with ReFILE for amendments (cra-docs-15). The agency's pages publish the enrollment path (cra-supp-3). Missing for 10: the enrollment and application steps are only summarized, not shown in detail; the evidenced channel covers only T1 individual returns, with no business, payroll or batch-provider transmitter channels; and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
